<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded Value'>">
  %pe;
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/ns/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Top-level commentary block covering element design -->
  <item>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing markup-like strings: <item>&internal;</item>
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>&internal;</item>
</catalog>
```

  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent "Entity text">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY bin SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <!ENTITY % macro "<!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA | sub)*>">
  %macro;
  <!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)>
]>
<?pi-target processing instruction data with "quotes"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub">
  <!-- Comment before child elements -->
  <child>
    <![CDATA[
      First CDATA block with entity reference: &ent;
    ]]>
  </child>
  <sub:child>
    <![CDATA[Another CDATA with <tag> syntax]]>
  </sub:child>
</root>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE config [
  <!ELEMENT config (setting)*>
  <!ELEMENT setting (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseValue">
  <!ENTITY extended "&base;Extended">
  <!ENTITY % dtdAttr "att CDATA #IMPLIED">
  <!ATTLIST setting %dtdAttr;>
]>
<?xml-debug level="verbose"?>
<config xmlns="urn:config:root" xmlns:param="urn:config:param">
  <!-- Configuration parameters and namespace test -->
  <param:setting att="test-attr">
    <![CDATA[
      Settings block containing arbitrary characters: <>&'"
    ]]>
  </param:setting>
  <setting>&extended;</setting>
</config>

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record)*>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "Value1">
  <!ENTITY e2 "&e1; Value2">
  <!ENTITY % extEnt SYSTEM "external.dtd">
  %extEnt;
]>
<?target-pi data="value"?>
<archive xmlns="http://xml.org/archive" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/">
  <!-- Archive records with multiple namespace bindings and CDATA -->
  <record xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.com">
    <![CDATA[
      <record-data>&e2;</record-data>
    ]]>
  </record>
  <record dc:title="Sample">&e2;</record>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % inner "<!ENTITY nested 'NestedEntityValue'>">
  %inner;
  <!ENTITY reference "Ref:&nested;">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY docFile SYSTEM "file.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet href="style.xsl" type="text/xsl"?>
<document xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:svg="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Multi-namespace document with complex nested entity evaluation -->
  <section>
    <![CDATA[
      Section CDATA payload: <svg:svg width="100" height="100"/>
    ]]>
  </section>
  <section>&reference;</section>
</document>
```
